description: Source domains Trooth must never link to or cite. Every subdomain is blocked too (www.heisman.com, anything.heisman.com). scripts/build-live-data.mjs strips these URLs from every bundle field and fails the build if one would still be written.

domains.reason: Heisman Trust ToS s10(iii) bans manual copying and s10(ix) bans deep links without written consent; s5 limits use to personal, non-commercial.
